title: what breed is the dog in this meme

messages.content: whats the breed of the dog in this meme looks like a cloud with legs hurry up

That sounds like a Bichon Frise. They're often described as fluffy, cloud-like dogs with cheerful personalities. If it's not that, it might be a Samoyed, which also has a cloud-like appearance but is larger. Hope that helps with your repost!
